headline: 28 contracts catalogued across Ethereum and Fraxtal; frxETH/sfrxETH tokens, V2 infrastructure, and admin/oracle addresses

findings.text: Etherscan and Fraxscan block explorers confirm frxETH token (0x5e8422345238f34275888049021821e8e08caa1f) and sfrxETH (0xac3E018457B222d93114458476f3E3416Abbe38F) on Ethereum with verified contract labels.

Official deployments doc at docs.frax.finance/frax-ether/frxeth-and-sfrxeth-token-addresses lists 15 chains with both frxETH and sfrxETH token addresses. Ethereum native frxETH at 0x5e8422345238f34275888049021821e8e08caa1f, sfrxETH at 0xac3E018457B222d93114458476f3E3416Abbe38F.

V2 contract addresses from docs.frax.finance/frax-ether/frxeth-code-and-v2-addresses include BeaconOracle (0xA2901F3EE8f4E9F5baC5379BC0CD1F8341280AB5), FraxEtherMinter V2 (0x7Bc6bad540453360F744666D625fec0ee1320cA3), FraxEtherRedemptionQueueV2 (0xfDC69e6BE352BD5644C438302DE4E311AAD5565b), LendingPool (0x24A1d1671a3Bd1C3cABb9B10724a4127d84e1Da0) on Ethereum.
GitHub repositories identified: FraxFinance/frxETH-public (V1) and FraxFinance/frxETH-v2-public (V2). V1 repo contains frxETH.sol, sfrxETH.sol, frxETHMinter.sol, OperatorRegistry.sol contract code.

Multi-chain enumeration: Ethereum has frxETH (0x5e8422345238f34275888049021821e8e08caa1f), sfrxETH (0xac3E018457B222d93114458476f3E3416Abbe38F); Fraxtal has wfrxETH (0xfc00000000000000000000000000000000000006), sfrxETH (0xFC00000000000000000000000000000000000005). Cross-chain LayerZero bridges also documented.
Role taxonomy established: token (frxETH, sfrxETH), vault (sfrxETH ERC-4626), minter (frxETHMinter V1 and V2), oracle (BeaconOracle), lending infrastructure (LendingPool), AMO helper contracts.

rationale.verdict: Discovery catalogued 28 protocol-controlled smart contracts from official documentation and GitHub repositories. Token addresses verified on Ethereum and Fraxtal across V1 and V2 architectures. No snapshot/block addresses or granular control/admin multisig details recovered in this run; those become targets for downstream control slices.

evidence.shows: Official token deployment addresses (frxETH and sfrxETH) across 15 chains including Ethereum native (0x5e8422345238f34275888049021821e8e08caa1f for frxETH, 0xac3E018457B222d93114458476f3E3416Abbe38F for sfrxETH) and Fraxtal (wfrxETH 0xfc00000000000000000000000000000000000006)

V2 contract addresses on Ethereum including BeaconOracle (0xA2901F3EE8f4E9F5baC5379BC0CD1F8341280AB5), FraxEtherMinter V2 (0x7Bc6bad540453360F744666D625fec0ee1320cA3), FraxEtherRedemptionQueueV2 (0xfDC69e6BE352BD5644C438302DE4E311AAD5565b), CurveLsdAmo (0xEcb9bBb97BD3C23e8f176075EDB3c68B9a1869Ae), LendingPool (0x24A1d1671a3Bd1C3cABb9B10724a4127d84e1Da0)

Frax team operational addresses including Investor Custodian (0x5180db0237291A6449DdA9ed33aD90a38787621c), Oracle updater bot (0xBB437059584e30598b3AF0154472E47E6e2a45B9), Utility/helper deployer (0x36a87d1e3200225f881488e4aeedf25303febcae)

Official V1 source repository with contract files: frxETH.sol (ERC20 with permit), sfrxETH.sol (ERC4626 vault), frxETHMinter.sol (minter/validator management), OperatorRegistry.sol. Single-chain, 365 sLoC in core scope.
Official V2 source repository with enhanced architecture including lending pool integration, validator pool abstraction, and multi-chain support infrastructure.

Frax Ether system architecture: three primary components (frxETH token, sfrxETH vault, FraxEtherMinter). frxETH used as gas token on Fraxtal L2. 10% fee retention: 8% protocol fee to FXS holders, 2% insurance fund.

unknowns: D6: Factory pattern enumeration not applicable - no factory detected in token/minter/oracle contracts
D2-offchain: frxETH Multisigs page (referenced in docs navigation) inaccessible during fetch; multisig addresses for protocol governance and treasury not catalogued this run

protocol_metadata.about: Frax Ether (frxETH) is a liquid ETH staking derivative that allows users to stake ETH with flexible amounts and instant liquidity through the Frax Finance ecosystem. The system comprises frxETH (a stablecoin loosely pegged to ETH), sfrxETH (an ERC-4626 vault earning staking yield), and the FraxEtherMinter (which converts ETH deposits into frxETH and manages validator deposits). frxETH serves as the gas token on the Fraxtal L2 blockchain, generating returns from Ethereum validator rewards distributed to sfrxETH holders after protocol fees (8% to FXS holders, 2% to insurance).
